en: Vintage divided-view postcard with two colorized photographs. The upper image shows a rustic inn with a long wooden veranda under a red-tiled roof, labeled 'Stampfe's Gastwirtschaft'. Several people in period clothing stand in front, with a horse-drawn cart nearby, and forested hills in the background. The lower image is a panoramic view of a small valley town surrounded by wooded hills, centered on a church with a tall steeple and clock tower, labeled 'Frauheim.'. Printing along the left edge and bottom credits the publisher and describes it as a hand-colored art card.
